Pallavi Iyer, pallavi.iyer167@example.com, +91 9738958998
New Delhi

Professional Summary
Analytical and detail-oriented professional with experience in translating business requirements into actionable insights. Strong background in data querying, visualization, and stakeholder communication. Comfortable working in Agile environments to deliver data-driven recommendations that improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

Technical Skills
SQL, Python3, Tableau, Power BI, MS Excel, Agile

Work Experience

Data Analyst, Paystack India (Oct 2025 - Aug 2026)
- Developed and maintained automated dashboards using Power BI to track transaction volumes and reconciliation KPIs, enabling a 15% reduction in monthly settlement discrepancies; leveraged SQL for data extraction and MS Excel for ad-hoc analysis.
- Performed complex data validation and cleansing using SQL and MS Excel to improve data quality across payment pipelines, resulting in a 20% decrease in reporting errors.
- Collaborated with product and operations teams in an Agile cadence to define metrics and build actionable reports; used Power BI to present findings to stakeholders and prioritize product fixes.

Business Analyst, Saffron Bank (Sep 2024 - Sep 2025)
- Conducted exploratory analysis using Python3 and SQL to identify customer segmentation opportunities, informing targeted campaign designs that projected a 10% uplift in engagement.
- Built interactive Power BI reports and MS Excel models to monitor loan origination workflow and conversion funnels, highlighting bottlenecks and proposing process improvements adopted by operations.
- Partnered with cross-functional teams in Agile sprints to translate business requirements into technical specifications and reporting deliverables.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
